routes.label: Compare the fee with the call savings

question: Plan A has a monthly fee of 30 yuan plus 0.1 yuan/minute; Plan B has no monthly fee and charges 0.15 yuan/minute. If someone makes 500 minutes of calls per month, which plan saves more money?
solution: Plan A: \(30+0.1\times500=80\) yuan; Plan B: \(0.15\times500=75\) yuan. Plan B costs less. (The two plans cost the same when \(30+0.1t=0.15t\), giving \(t=600\). Plan B costs less for fewer than 600 minutes of calls.)
